page_title: LEC 1-1 MON | Lecce v Monza 27/04/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+8' Alberto Santoro is looking at his watch and immediately ends this match.
90+6' 1 - 1 GOAL! That’s a great strike from the spot by Matteo Pessina (Monza) low into the left of the net, giving goalkeeper Wladimiro Falcone no chance!
90+6' Matteo Pessina (Monza) will take the responsibility and he is already preparing the ball.
90+5' The players claim that Lorenzo Venuti (Lecce) handled the ball and it seems they are right. Penalty awarded! Monza will take a penalty kick.
90+2' 1 - 0 Nikola Krstovic (Lecce) scores as he latches on to a pass and unleashes a perfect strike from the edge of the box that goes into the top right corner of the goal and past the goalkeeper.
90' We will have 4 min. of added time.
89' 3:0 – this is the current number of shots on target.
86' Samuele Birindelli (Monza) produces a dangerous lofted cross into the box which is intercepted.
84' Alexis Blin (Lecce) skips past his man but can't keep the ball in play.
82' The referee allows time for a substitution. Remi Oudin will be replaced by Santiago Pierotti (Lecce).
82' Luca Gotti has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Lorenzo Venuti (Lecce) replacing Valentin Gendrey.
81' A substitution has been made. Armando Izzo is replaced by Danilo D'Ambrosio (Monza).
78' It's a yellow card for Roberto Gagliardini (Monza).
76' Georgios Kyriakopoulos (Monza) slaloms his way past challenges, but an opposing player does well to get the ball away.
74' Alexis Blin (Lecce) commits a rough challenge and Alberto Santoro blows his whistle for a foul.
72' Nicola Sansone (Lecce) delivers a lovely cross into the penalty area. Nevertheless, an opposition defender is alert and averts the danger with a brilliant clearance.
71' Nikola Krstovic (Lecce) is booked after bringing down an opponent. Alberto Santoro had an easy-decision to make.
70' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Armando Izzo (Monza) was quite harsh and Alberto Santoro didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.
69' That's the end of the game for Jean-Daniel Akpa Akpro, who is replaced by Roberto Gagliardini (Monza).
68' Substitution. Patrick Dorgu makes his way off the pitch and Pontus Almqvist (Lecce) comes on as his replacement.
68' Raffaele Palladino has decided to make a change. Daniel Maldini (Monza) replaces Alessio Zerbin.
67' Samuele Birindelli (Monza) whips the ball into the penalty area, but one of the defenders is alert and spanks it away.
65' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Monza.
64' Patrick Dorgu (Lecce) produces a quality cross into the box, but the opposition's defence intercepts the ball and spanks it away.
61' Substitution. Joan Gonzalez (Lecce) has come on for Hamza Rafia.
60' Roberto Piccoli will be replaced by Nicola Sansone (Lecce).
59' Raffaele Palladino decides to make a substitution. Valentin Carboni will be replaced by Andrea Colpani (Monza).
58' The referee signals a substitution. Milan Djuric (Monza) is brought on as a substitute for Lorenzo Colombo.
55' The ball is cleared after Matteo Pessina (Monza) attempted to dribble past an opposing player.
53' Antonino Gallo (Lecce) sends the ball into the box from the side of the pitch, but his cross is blocked.
51' Alberto Santoro has a clear sight and sees a foul from Hamza Rafia (Lecce).
48' A cross from Valentin Gendrey (Lecce) fails to reach the box as the defence clears the ball away to safety.
46' The game restarts for the second half.
45+2' The end of the first half.
45' 1 additional min. will be played.
44' Roberto Piccoli (Lecce) creates himself some space and attempts to put the ball into the box. However, the defender gets an important foot in to clear.
42' Valentin Gendrey (Lecce) attempts to find the head of one of his teammates with a promising cross into the box, but a defender outjumps the attackers and averts the threat.
39' The corner is swung in but Monza can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.
39' The current number of shots on goal is 1:0.
36' Hamza Rafia (Lecce) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away.
34' Lecce seem to be finding their feet as they enjoy some possession. Great movement by the offensive players allows the defenders to set up the attack.
32' Valentin Carboni (Monza) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him.
29' Jean-Daniel Akpa Akpro (Monza) gives away a foul for a clumsy challenge. Referee Alberto Santoro saw the whole situation.
27' Georgios Kyriakopoulos (Monza) tries to send a pass but it's blocked.
25' The referee demonstrates he won't tolerate this behaviour. Remi Oudin (Lecce) is given a yellow card.
23' The cross into the penalty area from Patrick Dorgu (Lecce) needed to be more accurate in order to create a goal-scoring opportunity for his team.
21' It looked like the long-range shot by Georgios Kyriakopoulos (Monza) would end up in the net, but the effort went painfully wide of the right post. The goalkeeper was quite lucky this time.
20' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from Monza comes to nothing.
19' Monza can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.
17' An attempted cross from Antonino Gallo (Lecce) is cleared.
15' Lorenzo Colombo (Monza) has tested the patience of referee Alberto Santoro and goes into the book for a previous late challenge.
14' Another attempt to send the ball beyond the defence by Warren Bondo (Monza) is thwarted and cleared to safety.

12' Long passes, short passes and one-two passes. Monza are showcasing great team work by keeping possession and producing pin-point passes from player to player. The opposition's players are finding it very difficult to intercept at the moment.
10' Alexis Blin (Lecce) neatly controls a driven pass on the edge of the box, glances up and cracks a beautiful drive goalwards that sails just over the bar.
8' Monza have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.

7' Alessio Zerbin (Monza) attempts to find some of his teammates with a dangerous pass from the edge of the box. The opponent's defence, however, intercepts the effort and clears the ball to safety. The ball is out of play. Monza win a corner kick.
5' Dangerous play by Lorenzo Colombo (Monza). Alberto Santoro blows his whistle for a foul.
3' A fine lofted pass into the box, sent by Antonino Gallo (Lecce), is intercepted by the opposition's defence.
1' The first half has started.
